Cloud Engineer - Brackenridge Cloud

About the role
Brackenridge runs a multi-tenant ticketing platform and is growing its cloud team. The team works in two-week sprints, holds weekly demos and keeps documentation next to the code. Engineers pair often, give honest feedback and set aside time every sprint to improve tooling, and new colleagues are paired with a buddy for their first month.

Responsibilities
- Build and operate cloud infrastructure
- Automate deployments
- Support developers on platform questions

Requirements
- AWS in production
- Terraform
- Python scripting
- Kubernetes
- Linux administration

Nice to have
- Go

Benefits
- Flexible working hours and a yearly learning budget
- 25 days of paid leave plus public holidays
- We review every application and reply within two weeks
